source_locator: Official results PDF, May 19, 2020 General Election, Mayor column, CITY TOTALS row
verification_note: City of Norfolk Office of Elections posts this document as official results. Only one candidate, Kenneth Cooper Alexander, appeared on the ballot for mayor. source_locator: Official results PDF, November 5, 2024 General and Special Elections, Mayor page, CITY TOTALS row
